audit_items.proof_trace: The split is enforced at reserve.move:175-176: `protocol_seize_amount = liq_revenue_factor.int_mul(redeem_collateral_amount)` (floor truncation, ≤1 unit deviation from exact) and `liquidator_seize_amount = redeem_collateral_amount - protocol_seize_amount` (exact remainder). Their sum equals `redeem_collateral_amount` by construction, conserving all collateral. The `liq_revenue_factor` is admin-bounded to ≤100% (asset.move:80), and ADL paths intentionally set it to zero (market.move:590,658).
